name: comp_differentiableWithinAt_iff
statement: G → E} {s : Set G} {x : G} : DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 (iso ∘ f) s x ↔ DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 f s x

have_tree.type: DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 (iso.symm ∘ iso ∘ f) s x

name: comp_right_differentiableWithinAt_iff
statement: F → G} {s : Set F} {x : E} : DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 (f ∘ iso) (iso ⁻¹' s) x ↔ DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 f s (iso x)

have_tree.type: DifferentiableWithinAt 𝕜 ((f ∘ iso) ∘ iso.symm) s (iso x)

name: HasFDerivWithinAt.tendsto_nhdsWithin_nhdsNE
statement: HasFDerivWithinAt f f' s x) (hf' : ∃ C, AntilipschitzWith C f') : Tendsto f (𝓝[s \ {x}] x) (𝓝[≠] f x)

have_tree.type: (fun z ↦ f z - f x) ~[𝓝[s] x] fun z ↦ f' (z - x)

name: fderivWithin_comp_neg
statement: 𝕜 → F} {s : Set 𝕜} {x : 𝕜} : fderivWithin 𝕜 (fun a => f (-a)) s x = -fderivWithin 𝕜 f (-s) (-x)
